$ hemma completion bash
exit: 0
--- stdout ---
# bash completion for hemma
_hemma() {
    local cur prev words cword
    _init_completion 2>/dev/null || {
        cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
        prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"
        cword=$COMP_CWORD
    }

    local verbs="add update remove create enable disable defaults list verify apply deploy preflight doctor measure version help completion"
    local nouns="service host domain"
    local set_keys="dns-host deploy-host auth-snippet auth-service tunnel-dir local-networks"
    local flags="--fqdn -f --host -H --backend -b --auth --auth-mode --auth-groups --auth-policy-local --auth-policy-public --tunnel --public --ip --ssh --trusted-proxies --all -a --policy --fix --chdir -C --help -h"

    # First word: a verb (allow -C <dir> to precede it).
    if [[ $cword -eq 1 ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$verbs" -- "$cur") )
        return
    fi

    case "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" in
        add|update|remove|enable|disable)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$nouns" -- "$cur") )
                return
            fi
            ;;
        defaults)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "set" -- "$cur") )
                return
            elif [[ $cword -eq 3 && "${COMP_WORDS[2]}" == "set" ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$set_keys" -- "$cur") )
                return
            fi
            ;;
        completion)
            if [[ $cword -eq 2 ]]; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "bash zsh" -- "$cur") )
                return
            fi
            ;;
    esac

    if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
        return
    fi
}
complete -F _hemma hemma splitdns
--- stderr ---
--- files ---
